lines.text: Did you know? Cede is Latin for go.
Quick quiz! Which means out plus go?

words.mean: go up after, reach a goal
words.ex: If you work hard, you will succeed.
Do not exceed the speed limit.

publish.title: Cede root: proceed, succeed and exceed
publish.value: Cede comes from Latin "cedere" (to go, to yield). Words: proceed, succeed and exceed. proceed = pro + ceed; succeed = suc + ceed; exceed = ex + ceed.
